en.title: Minimum Sum of Adjacent Absolute Differences After Rearranging
en.description:
You may rearrange the array arbitrarily. Find the minimum sum of the absolute differences between adjacent elements; output only the cost, not the arrangement.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and solution; bounds missing from the source and corrections to the examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n integers. Full original bounds: 2≤n≤100000, 0≤a[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 2; 0; 10. They were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: The answer is the maximum minus the minimum, which needs only one scan.
